scope: Compiled standalone content-reader diagnostic, not GTA gameplay or a release build
checks: Synthetic original EBX fixture decodes expected names, scores, enums and booleans
Every truncation of synthetic fixture is rejected
Scalar field crossing the declared instance boundary is rejected
INT64_MIN and INT64_MAX relative string pointers are rejected without overflow
Odd RIFF chunk missing padding is rejected
Parent traversal and absolute source paths are rejected
Installed catalog records have unique source identities, valid names and nonnegative scores
Production convenience API uses generated sheet paths
remaining: GTA skate movement and trick recognition integration
